dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You don't need any kind of "camouflage" to fit into Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: People from everywhere and all walks of life congregate there. There isn't a thing you could wear that would stand out.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Huh? Really? Then I'll just wear what I've got on now...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You'll freeze to death.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Tactful as always.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I'll make you something more suitable for the cold. Come pick it up in two weeks.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Understood! Thanks, Chiori!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: It's nothing. Oh, and by the way? Those gloves you were eyeing earlier? They'd clash horribly with your look.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh... Oh! Well, I was... just browsing...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: And you won't "accidentally" bump into Clorinde in my shop either.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Wh—What? I... I wasn't...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: When she orders gloves from me, I usually have Kirara deliver them straight to her door.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: The only person you'll meet "camping" here for her is Chevreuse. Perhaps you've a taste for the Special Patrol's hospitality?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Nope! None at all! Zero interest!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Like I said. Two weeks. In-store pickup.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Y—Yes! Got it! And thanks...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, sorry to keep you waiting. If you'd like to buy something, just say so.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'm also just browsing...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Mmm. I'm a bit busy, so no invitations to come in for tea and chit-chat today.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You know our business hours, so if you'd like to try or buy, just drop by then.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I'll be heading back in. And little Miss Journalist, remember — two weeks.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Y—Yes! Absolutely!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* Looks like nothing gets past Chiori. Time to change tack...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You even came here to stalk Clorinde?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: *sigh* Someone told me that Clorinde sometimes comes here to buy gloves... Turns out he was playing me for a fool...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Forget it! That's not what matters now. My priority is to stock up and prep for my trip to Nod-Krai!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You convinced your parents?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Mom wasn't totally sold... But I never imagined how supportive Pops would be! He even gave me advice and helped plan some potential stories to— I mean, potential vacation spots to visit.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: And not only that — he helped buy a bunch of stuff and sent letters to his friends there, asking them to help look after me!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I already know them, though. Veteran reporters all!

choices.text: Sounds like your dad saw right through you...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Of course he did. He's the top reporter in all of Teyvat. Nothing gets by him. Naturally, he's the best dad too.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: #If we're lucky, {NICKNAME}, we'll see each other in Nod-Krai.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Hehe, of course. He's the best dad in the world. Naturally, he's the top reporter in all of Teyvat, too!
